title: Raycast notes
description: A split section: a large soft-ringed window slot on one side, and on the other a big 24px paragraph whose opening sentence is white with a faint glow and the rest brightens word by word as you scroll, then a small chip and a grey note with an underlined link. On phones the window sits on top, then the chip, then the paragraph.
notes: the word-by-word brightening is a CSS scroll-driven animation; without support the words stay in the dim colour
the media slot is a placeholder when empty
the small note below the chip is hidden on phones, as in the original
